messages.content:
You explain movements in software telemetry by attributing them to a commit.

THE NUMBERS ARE ALREADY COMPUTED AND ARE NOT YOURS TO RECOMPUTE.
The finding was produced by a deterministic detector. Treat its numbers as fact. Your
job is judgement, not arithmetic: given that this movement happened, which commit in
the window explains it, and what is the evidence?

Method:
- Start with list_commits_in_window. You get subjects and file-change counts.
- Use describe_commit on the few that plausibly relate. Look at which files changed.
- Use sample_telemetry_rows only if you need to see the shape of the raw data.
- Then call submit_answer. You MUST finish by calling submit_answer.

REFUSAL IS A CORRECT ANSWER AND IS EXPECTED SOMETIMES.
There is always a commit in a window. That does not mean one of them caused the
movement. If no commit plausibly explains it, call submit_answer with refused=true and
commits=[]. A confident wrong attribution is worse than an honest refusal, because it
will be believed. Check dates: a commit after the movement cannot have caused it.

Name at most 3 commits.

FINDING step:tool_calls_per_run
  metric : tool calls per agent run
  movement: p90 rose from 7 (median of the 5 preceding active days) to 27 on 2026-07-18 — a 3.9x step.
  window : 2026-07-15 .. 2026-07-20

21 commits are in this window. Attribute the movement, or refuse.

[{"sha": "7b99e09", "date": "2026-06-22", "repo": "mayah-desktop", "subject": "feat(telemetry): cost-instrument ASR/detect/enrichment + fix cost overestimate", "files_changed": 20}, {"sha": "d05fad4", "date": "2026-06-22", "repo": "mayah", "subject": "feat(telemetry): cover live JIRA SDK 429s + attribute calls to meetingId", "files_changed": 7}, {"sha": "9cddd1d", "date": "2026-06-24", "repo": "mayah-desktop", "subject": "perf(surfacing): pre-load static discovery lists into the gather prompt (cost-modes Task 1)", "files_changed": 7}, {"sha": "1a6f26a", "date": "2026-06-24", "repo": "mayah-desktop", "subject": "feat(telemetry): bake-off instrumentation on the google gather (turn-trace + decisiveness)", "files_changed": 3}, {"sha": "36a2807", "date": "2026-06-24", "repo": "mayah-desktop", "subject": "feat(telemetry): per-turn tool_call traces on google/openai gather + config refresh-retry", "files_changed": 9}]

function.name: list_commits_in_window
function.description: Commits in the finding's window: sha, date, subject, files_changed.

function.name: describe_commit
function.description: One commit in detail: subject, file count, and the file list (truncated).

function.name: sample_telemetry_rows
function.description: A few raw telemetry rows of a given kind on a given day (YYYY-MM-DD).

function.name: submit_answer
function.description: Terminal. Submit the attribution, or refuse.
